title: LeetCode 1000
description: The first 1000 LeetCode problems (950 algorithm problems; database/shell problems excluded) for offline practice. Organized by pattern following the NeetCode 250 style (arrays-hashing through bit-manipulation), plus union-find and segment-tree for dedicated topics in this range, and prefix-sum, strings, sorting, simulation and design split out from the large array/string group. Numbers shown are Cojudge course numbers (1-950 in category order). If you notice anything wrong (e.g. missing test cases, incorrect grading, or a miscategorized problem), please open an issue in the [repo](https://github.com/cojudge/cojudge).
